title: Pure Triamid
summary: Pure Triamid control deck, built around EARTH Rock monsters that continuously cycle through three ancient Field Spells on both players' turns. Sending one Field Spell to the GY immediately replaces it from the Deck while triggering floating searches, recoveries, and Special Summons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Triamid Hunter grants an additional Normal Summon of an EARTH Rock monster while any Field Spell is active on the field, allowing multiple bodies every turn.
Triamid Loading searches a Triamid Spell or Trap whenever a Field Spell is placed in the Field Zone, and Special Summons a Triamid monster from the Deck if your Rock monster is destroyed.
Triamid Cruiser draws 1 card and discards 1 card whenever a Normal Summoned Rock monster hits the field, and searches a Triamid monster from Deck when sent to the GY.
Triamid Master sends any face-up Triamid card you control to the GY to destroy 1 Set card the opponent controls.

summary.title: Opening: Hunter + Cruiser + Dancer
steps: Activate Triamid Cruiser, establishing your initial Field Spell.
Normal Summon Triamid Hunter; Cruiser triggers, allowing you to draw 1 card and discard 1 card.
Use Triamid Hunter's additional Normal Summon effect to Normal Summon Triamid Dancer.
Dancer shuffles a Triamid card from your GY back into the Deck to boost all Rock monsters you control by 500 ATK and DEF permanently.
During the opponent's turn, activate Hunter or Dancer's Quick Effect to send Cruiser to the GY and activate Triamid Kingolem or Triamid Fortress directly from your Deck.
Cruiser triggers in GY upon being sent, searching Triamid Sphinx from your Deck to hand.

summary.title: The Field Spell Rotation
points: Triamid Cruiser loots on Rock Normal Summons and adds a Triamid monster from Deck to hand when sent from the Field Zone to the GY.
Triamid Kingolem prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step when your Triamids battle, and Special Summons a Triamid from your hand when sent to GY.
Triamid Fortress gives Rock monsters 500 DEF and prevents them from being destroyed by opponent card effects, recovering a Triamid monster from GY to hand when sent to GY.
All Level 3 Triamid monsters (Hunter, Dancer, Master) share the Quick Effect during the opponent's turn to send the active Field Spell to the GY and place a different one directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Triamid Sphinx Special Summons itself from the hand whenever a Triamid card you control (including a Field Spell being swapped) is destroyed, gaining 500 ATK and DEF for each different Field Spell in your GY while forcing the opponent to only attack Sphinx.
Triamid Dancer recycles spent Triamids from GY while stacking cumulative 500 ATK/DEF boosts on all your Rock monsters.
Triamid Master eliminates threatening Set cards by sending expendable Triamid cards to the GY, triggering their floating effects.
Triamid Pulse banishes 2 Rock monsters or Field Spells from your GY to destroy a face-up card, revive a Rock monster in Defense Position, or shuffle 3 Rock monsters from GY into Deck to draw 1 card.
